description: suggestTown(machines, lat, lng, within) proposes a concelho to PREFILL the add-machine form with, and knownTowns(machines) lists the concelhos already on the map for the field's suggestion list. suggestTown is deliberately conservative: outside the radius it returns "" rather than a guess. That is not a detail — the database previously derived a submission's concelho from its nearest machine with no distance limit, and the first real submission landed 18.8 km away from its neighbour and was filed under the wrong concelho. A port must reproduce the empty answer, not just the populated one.

suggestTownCases.description: Standing next to an existing machine: its concelho is a good guess.
The real submission that exposed the bug: 18.8 km from the nearest machine, which sits in a different concelho. Must suggest nothing.
~1.5 km away, inside the 2 km default — still a reasonable guess.
~3.3 km away, past the 2 km default. Silence beats a wrong concelho.
Passing `within` widens or narrows the radius; 5 km accepts the same 3.3 km neighbour the default rejected.
A closer machine with no concelho must not shadow a usable one behind it — a user-added machine can legitimately have no town yet.
An empty map suggests nothing rather than throwing.
